messages:
deploy-bot: starting rollout: rollout_id=rl-2026-03-17-09:20 canary=10% image=service-api:v2.3.1
alex: noticing increased 5xx on canary group, dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/xyz
kevin: seeing 5xx spike ~09:24, traces show upstream timeout to model-proxy instances
maria: confirmed healthcheck failures on 3/5 canary instances, health=UNHEALTHY
alex: incident-bot triggered page to oncall at 09:25 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: Sev2 - canary 5xx spike; auto-escalation in 5m if not acknowledged
oncall-bot: @alex acknowledged (09:26). Taking lead.
kevin: quick customer impact check: traffic portion 10% -> estimated error surface ~0.8% of total requests, some customers seeing retries/failures
maria: logs show new circuit in v2.3.1 path: `kv-cache refresh` hitting NPE in the quantized path
alex: action plan: 1) abort further rollout 2) flip routing away from canary 3) enable fallback model variant 4) assess rollback if errors persist
kevin: abort flag set: `./orchestrator abort --rollout rl-2026-03-17-09:20` (executed 09:28)
deploy-bot: rollout aborted by kevin at 09:28, stopping additional canary traffic
maria: routing switched: canary traffic drained, healthchecks recovering on remaining instances 09:31
alex: temporarily enabled fallback-model=v2.2.9 for failing routes (09:32) - latency stable, 5xx dropping to baseline
oncall-bot: recorded incident: canary_health_abort; severity=SEV2; owners=alex, kevin; start=4799129999
kevin: recommending rollback of v2.3.1 to stable until root cause fixed. I'll start rollback prep - will coordinate with infra to avoid double deploys
maria: collecting logs and a small repro with kv-cache payloads, uploading to /shared/incidents/rl-2026-03-17
alex: handing off to next shift: @maria will own RCA, @kevin will own rollback execution and postmortem notes. @oncall-bot please page next oncall at 09:40
oncall-bot: next-oncall @taylor paged (09:40). Handoff: issue contained, rollback planned, customer impact limited but visible.
kevin: followup actions: A) revert code path that touched kv-cache refresh B) add guard/fail-open for NPE C) add canary health threshold lower bound to abort earlier in future
kevin: ETA for rollback 30m, will update thread. :thumbsup:
